CHAPTER 4 OVERVIEW
This chapter explores the critical role of governance and strategic partnerships in driving a just energy transition.

It emphasizes the need for comprehensive, integrated approaches that address the social, economic, and environmental dimensions of the transition, ensuring no one is left behind.

Key themes include the importance of proactive planning, strategic foresight, and the transformation of physical infrastructure to enhance resilience and equity.
The chapter also highlights the role of Just Energy Transition Partnerships (JETPs) as innovative financing mechanisms to support developing countries in shifting from fossil fuels to clean energy.
The chapter underscores the necessity of transparency, equity, and international cooperation to achieve sustainable and just energy transitions.

Lesson 3: Just Energy Transition Partnerships (JET-P)
This lesson explores Just Energy Transition Partnerships (JET-Ps) as innovative financing mechanisms to support developing nations in shifting from fossil fuels to clean energy.
It emphasizes blending public and private capital to phase out coal, upgrade grids, and retrain workers.
Challenges include ensuring equity, avoiding debt traps, and integrating grassroots priorities into national strategies.
Effective governance and inclusive frameworks are stressed to balance economic shifts with social justice and accountability.
